source_rehash.reason: run_energyplus gained an optional epw_path argument so a scenario weather file reaches EnergyPlus itself
source_rehash.why_it_was_needed: EnergyPlus's --weather overrides the model, so mb.set_weather_file() alone changed nothing: measured 2026-07-30, an EPW with every hour +5 K and the city renamed gave a byte-identical result while eplusout.eio named VALENCIA and the OSM named TESTCITY
source_rehash.physics_unchanged: epw_path defaults to None -> mb.EPW_FILE, i.e. the previous behaviour; pilot regression 11.21 / 16.60 kWh/m2 QA ALL PASSED, verified_model --verify 13/13 with every gate bit-identical to the previous golden
source_rehash.workbench_unaffected: simulation_adapter.py sets runner.mb.EPW_FILE around the call; with epw_path unset the fallback is still mb.EPW_FILE, so Part B/G behave exactly as before
source_rehash.no_result_invalidated: the project has only ever held one EPW (ESP_Valencia.082840_IWEC.epw), so no recorded run was ever produced through the broken --epw path
